verdict.rationale: Zero documents no sandbox, test mode, or dry-run environment for agents or MCP clients to exercise email actions without touching real mailbox data. The MCP surface (send, delete, bulk delete) works against live connected accounts. Self-hosting and the contributor dev setup (`pnpm go`, Drizzle Studio) are developer building blocks and user-side arrangements, not a product-provided sandbox isolated from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
